requestedAction: Mara slowly opens the amber-lit train door halfway with her right hand, revealing warm golden light, while continuing to hold her brass compass in her left hand.

response.title: Half‑Opened Door, Golden Glow
response.narration: Mara stands alone in the midnight Tokyo train, burnt‑orange coat bright against teal windows. She holds a brass compass in her left hand and, with her right, pushes the amber‑lit door until it is half‑open, spilling warm golden light into the carriage.
response.prompt: Mara, in her burnt‑orange coat, holds the brass compass in her left hand. She gently pushes the amber‑lit train door with her right hand until it is half‑open, revealing a wash of golden light that pools on the teal‑tinted floor. The camera glides slowly, keeping her centered in a single continuous shot.

choices.label: Step into the golden light
choices.detail: Mara walks forward through the doorway into the illuminated space.
choices.action: Mara lifts her right foot and steps across the threshold, entering the golden light while still gripping the brass compass; the door remains half‑open.

choices.label: Close the door and stare
choices.detail: She pulls the door shut, returning the carriage to darkness.
choices.action: Mara pulls the amber‑lit door back to its closed position, the golden light fades, and she gazes at the compass as the teal‑lit interior resumes.

choices.label: Turn the compass toward the light
choices.detail: She rotates the compass, its needle pointing at the glow.
choices.action: Mara rotates the brass compass in her left hand, aligning its needle toward the golden light spilling from the half‑open doorway; the door stays half‑open.
